extension.description: Oracle Database (19c and later) driver for SQL database assets: browse schemas, run SQL, edit tables, import and export
driver.serviceName.label: Service name
driver.serviceName.desc: The database service to connect to, such as ORCLPDB1. With "Connect by SID" on, enter the SID here instead
driver.useSID.label: Connect by SID
driver.useSID.desc: Use the value of "Service name" as the instance SID, for databases that are not reachable by service name
driver.role.label: Connect as
driver.role.desc: NORMAL for an ordinary login, or SYSDBA / SYSOPER to log in with that administrative privilege
